Heard on I.A. No.5813/2025 which is the seventh application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C., 1973/
430(1) of BNSS, 2023 for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant Manoj Shrivas.

This appeal has been preferred against the judgment of conviction and sentence dated 18/11/2016 passed by Special Judge (Atrocities), District Tikamgarh (M.P.) in S.T. No.200155/2014, whereby appellant has been convicted and sentenced as under:
In lieu of Conviction U/s. Imprisonment Fine default R.I. for 363 of IPC R.I. for 5 years Rs.500/-
3 months R.I. for 3 366 of IPC R.I. for 5 years Rs.500/-
months R.I. for 6 376 (2)(jha) of IPC Life Imprisonment Rs.1000/-
months R.I. for 3 3/4 of POCSO Act, 2012 R.I. for 7 years Rs.500/-
months 3(1)(XII) of SC/ST R.I. for 1 (Prevention of Atrocities) R.I. for 1 year Rs.200/- month Act 3 (2)(V) of SC/ST 2 CRA-3713-2016 3 (2)(V) of SC/ST R.I. for 6 (Prevention of Atrocities) Life Imprisonment Rs.1000/-
months Act
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that appellant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is further submitted that the age of the prosecutrix at the time of the incident was 12 years.
The appellant has no previous criminal history.

He has already undergone almost 12 years of incarceration therefore, in the light of law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Saudan Singh Vs. The State of Uttar Pradesh [SLP (Cri.) No.4633/2021], the application may be considered on the ground of period of incarceration.

sentences.text: Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, the medical report and the judgment passed by the Supreme Court in the case of Saudan Singh (supra) as well as the period of incarceration already undergone by the appellant, we are of the opinion that the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant can be considered.
Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, I.A. No.5813/2025 is allowed.

It is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, the remaining jail sentence of the appellant is 3 CRA-3713-2016 hereby suspended and he be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 23.01.2026 and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard during pendency of this appeal.
List the matter for final hearing in due course.
(VIVEK KUMAR SINGH) (AJAY  JUDGE   vy Manoj Shrivas vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/147180787/
